description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications, providing common functionality such as logging initialization. It extends FragmentActivity and sets up logging using custom LogWrapper and Log classes.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class that handles logging setup and common activity lifecycle behavior for Android sample applications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Called when the activity is first created; currently only calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Called when the activity becomes visible; calls the superclass method and initializes logging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the custom logging, wrapping Android's log framework and logging a 'Ready' message.
